description: Fix cd_view in apps/openagents-desktop/host.c so headless host_driver builds with UI_HOST_STUB_H return ui_view.

steps.send: In `apps/openagents-desktop/host.c`, `cd_view` currently checks `#ifdef __APPLE__`, which causes headless `host_driver` builds using `UI_HOST_STUB_H` on Linux to return `NULL`. Update the preprocessor guard in `cd_view` to `#if defined(__APPLE__) || defined(UI_HOST_STUB_H)` so stubbed builds return `ui_view(((CoderHost *)page)->app.host)`. Verify with `grep -q 'defined(UI_HOST_STUB_H)' apps/openagents-desktop/host.c`.
